name: WeChat Bridge
description: Connect a session to a WeChat account: WeChat messages go into the session, the agent's replies go back to the sender.
author: augentia

command_prefix.title: Command prefix
command_prefix.description: WeChat messages starting with this are bridge commands (e.g. \cmd status) and are not sent to the agent.

message_prefix.title: Message prefix
message_prefix.description: Prepended to every WeChat message the agent receives.

reply_mode.title: Replies sent to WeChat
reply_mode.description: final_only: only the turn's final answer. every_reply: also the text the agent writes before tool calls.
